questions.question: How much of a $100 sale does Amazon keep compared to Shopify?
questions.answer_summary: One 2026 channel-benchmark analysis puts it at roughly $44 kept by Amazon vs. $63 kept by Shopify on the same SKU at the same price, once all fees are counted.

questions.question: What are Amazon's referral and FBA fees in 2026?
questions.answer_summary: Most categories still charge a 15% referral fee (with some categories lower or much higher, e.g. device accessories at 45%), plus FBA fulfillment fees that rose an average $0.08/unit in 2026, though sub-$10 items got a fee cut of about $0.86/unit.

questions.question: What's the all-in cost of selling on Amazon once every fee is included?
questions.answer_summary: One estimate puts total Amazon selling costs (referral, fulfillment, storage, returns, advertising) at roughly 30-45% of an item's selling price in 2026.

questions.question: Why has customer acquisition cost (CAC) risen so much for DTC brands?
questions.answer_summary: Reports cite CAC up 40-60% since 2023 (and 222% over eight years cumulatively), driven by structural ad-market forces: Google Shopping CPCs up ~33.72% in 2025 and Meta CPMs hitting all-time highs (~$22.98 in Q4).

questions.question: Why are DTC brands opening physical retail stores again?
questions.answer_summary: Coverage frames this as a direct response to unsustainable paid-social CAC — brands are using physical retail and 'rent' as a lower-CAC acquisition channel, summarized as 'rent is the new CAC.'

questions.question: Does Amazon or Shopify give a brand better repeat-purchase/customer-ownership economics?
questions.answer_summary: Analysis argues Shopify lets a brand retain the customer relationship (email/SMS/loyalty/subscriptions) so repeat purchases get cheaper over time, whereas Amazon effectively charges a fresh referral fee on every repeat transaction.

questions.question: Which product categories see the widest margin gap between Amazon and Shopify?
questions.answer_summary: A contribution-margin breakdown cites beauty/skincare as the widest gap (about 20% Amazon vs. 32% Shopify) and supplements similarly (18% vs. 28%), attributed to light, high-margin SKUs with strong Shopify subscription economics.

questions.question: How much combined market share do Amazon and Shopify have in US ecommerce now?
questions.answer_summary: One 2026 report states Amazon and Shopify together now control about 50% of US ecommerce.

questions.question: What changed in Amazon's 2026 fee update, and how did it affect sellers?
questions.answer_summary: Amazon's official 2026 update kept most referral fee percentages flat but raised FBA fulfillment fees by an average $0.08/unit while cutting fees on sub-$10 items by about $0.86/unit.

questions.question: Is the standard playbook now 'sell on Amazon AND build a Shopify DTC presence' rather than choosing one?
questions.answer_summary: Multiple 2026 sources describe the fastest-growing brands as running both channels deliberately — Amazon for reach/discovery, Shopify for owned customer relationships and repeat-purchase margin.

questions.question: How much has DTC customer acquisition cost increased over the long run (not just recently)?
questions.answer_summary: An L.E.K. Consulting analysis cited puts the cumulative CAC increase at 222% over roughly eight years.
